title: Closing Calendar Figures for Home Purchase Agreement Collections
content:
Each collection of the Home Purchase Agreement carries its own closing calendar and charge figures: the minimum notice before the scheduled closing date, the timing of the new home orientation, the buyer's closing extensions and their fee, the per diem for buyer delay and its grace days, and the buyer delay after which a default notice is sent.

| Collection | Minimum closing date notice (calendar days) | Orientation (calendar days before closing) | Buyer closing extensions allowed | Closing extension days | Closing extension fee (USD) | Per diem (USD per calendar day) | Per diem grace days | Buyer delay before default notice (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pathway Collection | 30 | 7 | 2 | 7 | 500.00 | 75.00 | 0 | 30 |
| Meadow Collection | 30 | 7 | 2 | 7 | 500.00 | 95.00 | 0 | 30 |
| Heritage Collection | 30 | 7 | 2 | 10 | 750.00 | 125.00 | 1 | 30 |
| Crestview Collection | 30 | 10 | 2 | 10 | 1000.00 | 165.00 | 1 | 30 |
| Summit Collection | 45 | 10 | 2 | 14 | 1500.00 | 225.00 | 2 | 45 |
| Reserve Collection | 45 | 14 | 3 | 14 | 2500.00 | 325.00 | 2 | 45 |

## Column definitions

- **Minimum closing date notice**: the fewest calendar days allowed between the closing date notice and the scheduled closing date.
- **Orientation**: the calendar days before the scheduled closing date on which the new home orientation is held.
- **Buyer closing extensions allowed**: the most buyer-requested closing extensions an agreement may carry.
- **Closing extension days**: the collection's closing extension length in calendar days.
- **Closing extension fee**: the fee per buyer-requested closing extension.
- **Per diem**: the per diem in US dollars per calendar day charged when the buyer delays closing beyond the scheduled closing date.
- **Per diem grace days**: the calendar days after the scheduled closing date before the per diem begins; 0 in the Pathway and Meadow Collections.
- **Buyer delay before default notice**: the calendar days of buyer delay after the scheduled closing date after which a default notice is sent.

## Reading a row (hypothetical)

A hypothetical Reserve Collection agreement reads 45 days of minimum notice, an orientation 14 days before closing, up to 3 buyer extensions of 14 days at 2500.00 each, a per diem of 325.00 with 2 grace days, and a default notice once buyer delay passes 45 days.
